skirmish.module.killcam.setting.radius.t: Players within this distance of you are recorded (you always are).
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.after_de: How long the recording continues after your death, to show what the killer did next. The 10 seconds before the death are always kept.
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.default_: Which view the replay starts from
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.loop.too: Start over at the end instead of pausing.
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.hide_dro: Items, experience orbs and projectiles are live, not recorded: hide them during the replay (your scattered loot would float around the fight).
skirmish.killcam.watch.unavailable: Nothing was recorded for this death
skirmish.killcam.title: KillCam
skirmish.killcam.camera_note.no_killer: No killer recorded: orbiting around you
skirmish.killcam.camera_note.killer_away: Killer out of range at this moment
skirmish.killcam.help_free: Free camera: WASD, jump/sneak for up/down, sprint for speed
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.record_s: How many seconds to keep in memory
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.hud_indi: “KillCam · last N s” pill on screen
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.save_mod: Automatically write your kills and deaths (the last seconds of the recording) to disk. The “Save the moment” key always works.
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.clip_key: Save the last seconds of the recording as a clip
Saved kills, deaths and clips: watch, star, rename, delete.
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.max_repl: How many replays to keep on disk. Beyond the limit the oldest ones are deleted, except starred ones.
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.max_mb.t: Size limit of the replay folder. Beyond the limit the oldest replays are deleted, except starred ones.
skirmish.module.killcam.setting.stop_on_: Closes a saved replay you are watching when you take damage.
skirmish.killcam.saved_note.elsewhere: Recorded elsewhere: players are shown without their surroundings
skirmish.killcam.saved.nothing: nothing to save: the recording is empty
skirmish.killcam.library.title: My replays
skirmish.killcam.library.empty: Nothing here yet. Kills and deaths are saved automatically, and the “Save the moment” key (%s) saves the last seconds at any time.
skirmish.killcam.library.hint: Replays play in the current world: away from where they were recorded, players are shown without surroundings
skirmish.killcam.library.hint_no_world: Replays can only be watched while in a world
skirmish.killcam.library.rename.title: Replay name
skirmish.killcam.library.rename.body: Leave empty for the default name.
skirmish.killcam.library.delete.title: Delete replay?
skirmish.killcam.library.delete.body: “%s” will be deleted from disk for good.
skirmish.killcam.library.error.start: Could not start the replay (details in debug.log)
